# BAD-014 — Choicer Voicer export with a separated bed and a baked watermark

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 11. The Choicer Voicer export does not exist yet. A scene exported for the original game plays silent between lines unless it carries a background bed: planPack emits _backing_track only when separation has run, and Choicer Voicer has no sceneFillItems fallback. This export runs separation and produces a pack the original game actually plays, which is the compute a paid tier can justify.

Rules from the TODO that are not obvious:
- Never gate it by breaking the free export. v1 compatibility is kept on purpose (packInfoIni writes icon= beside thumbnail= for exactly this), a broken free export would be trivially undone by hand, and it degrades what markets the app.
- Excludes takes/ unconditionally, like every other export.
- The pack's scene video should carry the Bad Takes watermark baked in, so a pack shared in the Choicer Voicer community names where it came from. Reuse brandedExportArgs' chip recipe from src/brand.js at assembly time.

Depends on separation being available to the player, locally ([[BAD-013]], prebuilt demucs.cpp) or as a cloud job (TODO 11's cloud separation, after [[BAD-011]] establishes cloud jobs). Read docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-18-tiered-cloud-generation-design.md for why this export is the paid artifact.
